rows.reply:
<title>ST: Tank Fill Valve Control (Structured Text)</title>
language st
PROGRAM TankValveControl
VAR
    LowFloat AT %I0.0 : BOOL;    (* Input: Low Float Switch *)
    HighFloat AT %I0.1 : BOOL;   (* Input: High Float Switch *)
    FillValve AT %Q0.0 : BOOL;   (* Output: Fill Valve *)
    DrainPump AT %Q0.1 : BOOL;   (* Output: Drain Pump *)
    FillTimer AT %Q0.2 : BOOL;   (* Output: Fill Timer *)
    DrainTimer AT %Q0.3 : BOOL;  (* Output: Drain Timer *)
    Phase : INT := 0;              (* 0: Idle, 10: Filling, 20: Settling, 30: Draining, 99: Alarm *)
    InPhase : TON;
    LastPhase : INT := -1;
END_VAR

(* Initialize timers to 0 when the program starts *)
InPhase(IN := 0, PT := T#0s);
DrainTimer(IN := 0, PT := T#0s);

(* Main Control Logic *)
CASE Phase OF
    0:  (* Idle Phase *)
        IF LowFloat THEN Phase := 10;
        END_IF;
    10: (* Filling Phase *)
        IF HighFloat THEN Phase := 20;
        ELSIF InPhase.Q THEN Phase := 99; (* Fill took too long *)
        END_IF;
    20: (* Settling Phase *)
        IF InPhase.ET >= T#10s THEN Phase := 30; END_IF;
    30: (* Draining Phase *)
        IF LowFloat THEN Phase := 0; END_IF;
    99: (* Alarm Phase *)
        Phase := 99;
END_CASE;

(* Output Control Logic *)
FillValve := (Phase = 10);
DrainPump := (Phase = 30);
FillTimer := (Phase = 10);
DrainTimer := (Phase = 30);
END_PROGRAM
END
